cases.desc: Verify Home screen shows illustration, headline, six tiles and Login button.
cases.expected: Illustration, 3-line headline, six tiles (3 + 3) and one Login button are shown on blue background; no Register Now, chatbot or accessibility icon.
cases.approach: unit-testable - screen test asserts the illustration, the exact three-line headline, the seven buttons ending in Login, no Register Now, chatbot or accessibility label, and the page background token #035795; grid test asserts the 3 + 3 layout

cases.desc: Verify tile labels and order.
cases.expected: Order is Pay Now, Our Products, Track Application, FAQs, Offers, Contact Us with exact label capitalisation.
cases.approach: unit-testable - screen test asserts the button labels equal Pay Now, Our Products, Track Application, FAQs, Offers, Contact Us, Login in that order; constants and accessibility tests assert the same order

cases.desc: Verify Home screen loads without waiting for background calls.
cases.expected: Home is drawn and tappable immediately; no blocking loader.
cases.approach: unit-testable - new screen test asserts all six tiles and Login are drawn, no loading overlay, and a Login press navigates while the token and version promises are both pending; bootstrap test asserts no dialog and blocking false while the version call is pending

cases.desc: Verify Pay Now action opens the payment portal.
cases.expected: WebView opens the configured payment portal URL with title Pay Now.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: the case expects a WebView on the payment portal URL titled Pay Now; the recorded owner decision is no WebView, a Pay Now screen with a header and back button only (spec plan-stage decision 2, O-05); the Home hand-off to that screen is tested but the case is not

cases.desc: Verify Our Products action routes to Products.
cases.expected: Products screen opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - useHomeActions test asserts navigate is called with Products for the Our Products tile

cases.desc: Verify Track Application action routes to its destination.
cases.expected: User is taken to the Track Application destination (destination pending confirmation, BRD O-03).
cases.approach: unit-testable - useHomeActions test asserts navigate is called with TrackApplication for the Track Application tile (destination flow is a separate BRD, O-03)

cases.desc: Verify FAQs action opens FAQ screen.
cases.expected: FAQ screen opens with the FAQ list.
cases.approach: unit-testable - useFaqFlow and screen tests assert the fetched list is stored and navigate is called with Faq

cases.desc: Verify Offers action routes to non-logged Offers.
cases.expected: Offers (non-logged) screen opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - useHomeActions test asserts navigate is called with Offers for the Offers tile

cases.desc: Verify Contact Us action opens the Customer Care popup.
cases.expected: Popup "We are here to help!" opens over Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - screen test asserts the popup text "We are here to help!" shows over Home with no navigation; hook test asserts the popup opens without a route change

cases.desc: Verify Login button routes to Login screen.
cases.expected: Login screen opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - screen and useHomeActions tests assert navigate is called with LoginScreen after cta_clicked

cases.desc: Verify FAQ action fetches content when cache is not available.
cases.expected: Spinner shows, FAQ API is called and FAQ screen opens with response data.
cases.approach: unit-testable - screen test asserts the spinner shows and Faq opens on a pending then resolved fetch; hook test asserts one request and the stored list; service tests assert the empty POST to fetch-faq and the list returned

cases.desc: Verify FAQ action uses cached content when available.
cases.expected: FAQ screen opens immediately from cache with no new API call.
cases.approach: unit-testable - useFaqFlow test asserts Faq opens from cache with no fetch call and no spinner

cases.desc: Verify user returns to Home after closing the Pay Now WebView.
cases.expected: User returns to Home safely.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: the case closes a Pay Now WebView; no WebView exists by owner decision (O-05). The Pay Now screen back button is tested to navigate to NonLoggedInHome (PayNowScreen.test.tsx), but that is not the case as written

cases.desc: Verify FAQ API failure with no cache shows error.
cases.expected: Spinner closes and error dialog shows: Your request could not be processed at this moment. Request you to try again after sometime. User stays on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - useFaqFlow and screen tests assert the spinner clears, the exact error text shows, Okay closes it and navigate is not called

cases.desc: Verify Pay Now URL unavailable is handled.
cases.expected: No crash; WebView error or fallback is shown and user can return to Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: the case expects a WebView error or fallback when the Pay Now URL is unavailable; there is no WebView and no URL (O-05, O-09 payment URL no longer used); the Pay Now screen has no network content to fail

cases.desc: Verify stale session flags are reset on Home entry.
cases.expected: Non-logged route flags are reset and Home behaves as a fresh visitor.
cases.approach: unit-testable - useFocusReset test asserts the offers form, selected offer and register return flag are reset on focus, and a stale selected offer is cleared on first mount

cases.desc: Verify Home works when non-logged token generation succeeds.
cases.expected: All quick actions remain accessible.
cases.approach: unit-testable - new screen test asserts seven buttons, none disabled, and a tile press navigates after the token request succeeds

cases.desc: Verify token generation failure is handled silently.
cases.expected: No error shown; Home stays stable and usable (BRD NLH-E01). A later FAQ call may show its own error dialog.
cases.approach: unit-testable - new screen test asserts no Okay button, no FAQ error text and no overlay after a rejected token request and a later FAQ failure shows its own dialog; service tests assert every token failure resolves quietly

cases.desc: Verify no dialog when app version is up to date.
cases.expected: No dialog; Home usable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - versionService test asserts an equal version returns kind none; VersionDialog test asserts none renders nothing

cases.desc: Verify maintenance dialog is shown.
cases.expected: Blocking dialog shows the server message with Exit button (Android); cannot be dismissed.
cases.approach: unit-testable - VersionDialog test asserts the server message, Exit as the only button on Android and no dismissal on back; versionService test asserts kind maintenance with the message

cases.desc: Verify mandatory update dialog.
cases.expected: Blocking dialog "Update your app to experience all the latest features." with Update and Exit; cannot be dismissed.
cases.approach: unit-testable - VersionDialog test asserts the exact update text with Update and Exit and no dismissal; versionService test asserts kind mandatory; screen test asserts the dialog shows on a drawn Home

cases.desc: Verify Update button opens the store link.
cases.expected: Play Store (Android) or App Store (iOS) opens target_url.
cases.approach: unit-testable - VersionDialog test asserts onUpdate gets the target url; useHomeBootstrap test asserts Linking.openURL is called with the store url

cases.desc: Verify optional update dialog can be dismissed.
cases.expected: Dismissable dialog shows; Home usable after dismiss.
cases.approach: unit-testable - VersionDialog test asserts Update and Skip show and Skip closes; hook test asserts Skip returns the outcome to none; versionService test asserts kind optional

cases.desc: Verify update is not enforced when status is not Active.
cases.expected: No dialog is shown.
cases.approach: unit-testable - versionService and contract tests assert a status other than Active returns kind none

cases.desc: Verify version 1.8.10 is treated newer than 1.8.9.
cases.expected: Mandatory update dialog is shown (numeric part-by-part compare).
cases.approach: unit-testable - versionService test asserts compareVersions(1.8.9, 1.8.10) is -1 and the 1.8.10 body gives kind mandatory

cases.desc: Verify 401 from version service shows message and logs out.
cases.expected: Server message shows with Okay; on Okay the logout call runs.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: the case expects the server message with Okay and a logout call on Okay; the recorded decision is a 401 shows no popup and the logged-in token is cleared silently (spec plan-stage decision 3, overrides BRD 4.7.4)

cases.desc: Verify version call failure or empty body fails open.
cases.expected: No dialog; Home usable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - versionService and contract tests assert null, empty, malformed bodies and a failed request give none; hook test asserts a rejected call leaves no dialog

cases.desc: Verify version request sends capitalised platform value.
cases.expected: user_agent is exactly Android or iOS (capitalised) and version is the installed version.
cases.approach: unit-testable - versionService and contract tests assert the body is { version: 1.8.9, user_agent: Android } and user_agent is exactly iOS on iOS

cases.desc: Verify iOS has no Exit button on blocking dialogs.
cases.expected: Only Update is available; no Exit; dialog cannot be dismissed.
cases.approach: unit-testable - VersionDialog test asserts only Update shows on iOS and back does not dismiss

cases.desc: Verify blocking dialog cannot be dismissed by Android back.
cases.expected: Dialog stays open; app is not exited and Home is not reachable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - VersionDialog tests assert the Android back request calls neither the skip, okay nor exit handler; useExitConfirm test asserts back is swallowed while blocked

cases.desc: Verify exit confirmation shows on Android back.
cases.expected: Dialog "Are you sure you want to exit!" with CANCEL and Okay shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - ExitConfirmDialog and screen tests assert the exact text with CANCEL and Okay shows on back

cases.desc: Verify Okay on exit dialog closes the app.
cases.expected: App exits.
cases.approach: unit-testable - screen and hook tests assert BackHandler.exitApp is called once on Okay

cases.desc: Verify CANCEL on exit dialog keeps user on Home.
cases.expected: Dialog closes; user stays on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - hook test asserts the dialog hides on CANCEL and exitApp is not called; screen test asserts the dialog text is gone

cases.desc: Verify back closes Contact Us popup before exit dialog.
cases.expected: First back closes popup only; second back shows exit dialog.
cases.approach: unit-testable - screen test asserts the first back closes the popup with no exit dialog and the second back shows the exit dialog

cases.desc: Verify FAQ back returns to Home.
cases.expected: Home screen is shown.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: useFaqFlow asserts the faqsFromNonLogin flag is set when the FAQ opens; blocked: FAQ screen back handling (the Faq route is a stub in this repo)

cases.desc: Verify offers form data is cleared on return to Home.
cases.expected: Offers fields are empty.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - useFocusReset and slice tests assert the offers form equals empty strings and false after reset

cases.desc: Verify selected pre-approved offer is cleared on return to Home.
cases.expected: Selected offer is cleared.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - useFocusReset, screen and slice tests assert selectedOffer is null after focus

cases.desc: Verify register return flag is cleared on return to Home.
cases.expected: Register CIF field is not pre-filled or locked from the stale origin.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: useFocusReset and screen tests assert registerNowReturnScreen is null after focus; blocked: Register Now screen CIF field (module not in this repo)

cases.desc: Verify Offers fail screen Ok returns to Home with reset state.
cases.expected: Home shows and offers state is reset.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: useFocusReset asserts the reset runs on every later focus (loop of three returns); blocked: Offers failure screen Ok navigation (Offers route is a stub in this repo)

cases.desc: Verify focus reset does not clear FAQ cache or token.
cases.expected: FAQ opens from cache; token still used on requests.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - new screen test asserts after a focus event the FAQ opens from cache, fetchFaq is not called and the token is still APP; hook and slice tests assert the cache and token survive

cases.desc: Verify popup heading and three rows.
cases.expected: Heading We are here to help!; rows Call Us 022-45297300, Email Us bhflwecare@bajajhousing.co.in, Find Us Branch locator.
cases.approach: unit-testable - popup and constants tests assert the heading and the three rows with their exact details

cases.desc: Verify popup closes with its close control.
cases.expected: Popup closes and Home is shown.
cases.approach: unit-testable - popup test asserts close control, backdrop and Android back each call onClose; screen test asserts the popup text is gone after the close control

cases.desc: Verify focus returns to Contact Us tile after closing popup.
cases.expected: Focus returns to the Contact Us tile.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: useCustomerCare asserts setAccessibilityFocus is called with the tile handle on close; manual remainder: a person confirms with TalkBack or VoiceOver that focus lands on the Contact Us tile

cases.desc: Verify popup scrolls at large text sizes.
cases.expected: Popup height is capped, content scrolls inside, nothing clipped.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: popup test asserts the height cap (window - insets - 64 = 678) and a scroll container; manual remainder: a person checks on a device at large text that nothing is clipped

cases.desc: Verify Call, Email and Find Us tap behaviour.
cases.expected: Dialer, mail app and branch locator open as confirmed (BRD O-06, behaviour pending).
cases.approach: unit-testable - useCustomerCare tests assert tel:02245297300, mailto:bhflwecare@bajajhousing.co.in and navigate BranchLocator, each closing the popup

cases.desc: Verify popup opens only once on rapid taps.
cases.expected: Only one popup instance opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - new screen test asserts exactly one contact-popup after two rapid taps; hook test asserts a second open does not stack

cases.desc: Verify Bearer token is sent on FAQ request.
cases.expected: Authorization: Bearer token plus app-version, platform and device-details headers are present.
cases.approach: unit-testable - httpClient and FAQ contract tests assert Authorization Bearer, app-version, platform and device-details

cases.desc: Verify token request times out after 10 seconds.
cases.expected: Request aborts at 10 s with no UI error; Home usable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - authService test asserts timeout 10000 and a swallowed timeout error; screen test asserts Home stays usable after a rejected token request

cases.desc: Verify early FAQ tap waits for in-flight token.
cases.expected: FAQ request waits for the token and succeeds without 401.
cases.approach: unit-testable - httpClient test asserts no request is sent until the token provider resolves and then Bearer late-token is sent; authService test asserts an early token read waits for the in-flight request

cases.desc: Verify relaunch after 15 minutes uses a fresh non-logged token.
cases.expected: New non-logged token is generated; stale logged-in token is not used.
cases.approach: unit-testable - authService test asserts the logged-in token is never returned and a fresh token is requested; contract test asserts the logged-in slot is untouched

cases.desc: Verify FAQ shows error after token failure.
cases.expected: FAQ request fails and error dialog shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - new screen test asserts that after a rejected token request a failing FAQ call shows the exact error text and fetchFaq is called once

cases.desc: Verify token request body fields are encrypted.
cases.expected: username and password are encrypted, not plain text; no credentials in release logs.
cases.approach: unit-testable - authService test asserts username and password are sent as enc(...) only and a release-build run writes no credentials to the console; encryption tests assert the base64url IV:ciphertext format

cases.desc: Verify token is stored after success.
cases.expected: Token held in memory and in encrypted storage key auth_token_Nonlogged.
cases.approach: unit-testable - authService test asserts the token is in the store and under the key auth_token_Nonlogged

cases.desc: Verify empty FAQ list keeps user on Home with no dialog.
cases.expected: Spinner closes; user stays on Home; no dialog.
cases.approach: unit-testable - useFaqFlow test asserts no navigation, no dialog, spinner cleared and no stored list for an empty list; service test asserts an empty array stays empty

cases.desc: Verify non-array FAQ response does not crash.
cases.expected: Treated as empty; no crash; stays on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - faqService and contract tests assert every non-array body resolves to an empty list; the empty-list flow test asserts Home stays with no dialog

cases.desc: Verify double tap on FAQs sends one request.
cases.expected: Only one FAQ request is made.
cases.approach: unit-testable - useFaqFlow test presses three times and asserts fetch is called once

cases.desc: Verify spinner blocks other touches while FAQ loads.
cases.expected: Touches are blocked until the spinner closes.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: LoadingOverlay tests assert a modal, labelled, announced overlay and a swallowed Android back; manual remainder: a person confirms on a device that touches on tiles are blocked until the spinner closes

cases.desc: Verify retry after FAQ failure succeeds.
cases.expected: FAQ screen opens on second attempt.
cases.approach: unit-testable - useFaqFlow test asserts a failure then a retry opens Faq and fetch is called twice

cases.desc: Verify Okay on FAQ error dialog keeps user on Home.
cases.expected: Dialog closes; user remains on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - new screen test asserts after Okay the error text is gone, navigate is not called and Login is still shown; hook test asserts the dialog closes

cases.desc: Verify spinner always clears on FAQ failure or timeout.
cases.expected: Spinner clears and error dialog shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - new useFaqFlow test asserts a timeout error clears the spinner and shows the dialog; the failure test asserts the same for a 500

cases.desc: Verify Home renders with no network.
cases.expected: Home renders fully; only API-backed actions degrade.
cases.approach: unit-testable - new screen test asserts all six tiles, Login and the headline render and no Okay or Update button shows when the token and version calls both fail

cases.desc: Verify FAQs with no network shows error.
cases.expected: Error dialog shows; spinner clears.
cases.approach: unit-testable - new useFaqFlow test asserts a Network Error clears the spinner, shows the dialog and stores nothing

cases.desc: Verify Pay Now with no network shows WebView error.
cases.expected: WebView error state shows; user can go back to Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: the case expects a WebView error state with no network; there is no WebView, the Pay Now screen opens with no network content (spec N-10)

cases.desc: Verify network lost mid FAQ fetch.
cases.expected: Request fails; spinner clears; error dialog shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - new useFaqFlow test asserts loading is true while pending, then a rejection clears it and shows the dialog

cases.desc: Verify rapid taps on different tiles open one destination.
cases.expected: Only one destination opens; no duplicate stack entries.
cases.approach: unit-testable - guarded navigation, useHomeActions and screen tests assert three rapid taps on different destinations call navigate once

cases.desc: Verify rapid taps on the same tile do not duplicate screens.
cases.expected: Offers opens once; back returns to Home in one step.
cases.approach: unit-testable - new guarded navigation test asserts three taps on Offers navigate once and a tap after focus navigates again

cases.desc: Verify layout on small screen 320 x 568.
cases.expected: Content scrolls; Login reachable; nothing clipped.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: new screen test asserts at 320 x 568 Login and all seven buttons sit inside the scroll view; manual remainder: a person checks on a small device that nothing is clipped

cases.desc: Verify layout on tablet or wide screen.
cases.expected: Content is centred and tiles are not stretched (BRD O-13 pending).
cases.approach: out-of-scope - tablet and wide-screen layout rules are an open BRD item (O-13); nothing to test yet

cases.desc: Verify cold start time to interactive.
cases.expected: Within the agreed target (BRD PERF-1, pending).
cases.approach: manual - cold-start time to interactive on a mid-range device cannot be proven by a unit test (PERF-1, 2 s target)

cases.desc: Verify no memory growth when opening and closing tiles repeatedly.
cases.expected: Memory stays stable; no crash.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: lifecycle tests assert 50 mount and unmount cycles and 50 popup open and close cycles leave the live listener count unchanged; manual remainder: a person checks device memory and crashes over repeated tile open and close

cases.desc: Verify Android and iOS parity.
cases.expected: Same layout and flows, except hardware back and Exit button (Android only).
cases.approach: manual - Android and iOS parity of layout and flows needs both real devices; platform branches (Exit button, hardware back) are unit tested separately
